title: Unauthenticated GET leaks group membership lists
description:
File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/groups_collection.py

spec/12-apps.md 18.8.2 Membership Synchronization: Full membership list is NOT broadcast (privacy). Authoritative GET /groups/{id}/members is specified with OSCORE group context.

Current behavior:
- public_group_document (53-67) includes owner, admins, and members
- GroupsItemResource.render_get len==1 (204-210) returns that document to any client
- render_get len==2 rest[1]==members (222-232) returns the same lists with no OSCORE check

Anyone who can CoAP GET the node learns the full member and admin sets. GET /groups listing also exposes names and member counts (89-99) with no access control; that is weaker but still a roster oracle when combined with item GET.
acceptance_criteria: GET /groups/{id}/members requires OSCORE group (or pairwise owner/admin) context; unprotected GET returns 4.01/4.03. GET /groups/{id} MUST NOT include the full members/admins arrays unless the requester is authorized per 18.8.2.
close_reason: public_group_document no longer carries admins/members; item GET serves roster arrays only to authorized viewers (group OSCORE context or roster-affiliated pairwise peer); GET /groups/{id}/members requires OSCORE - bare request 4.01, authenticated-but-unaffiliated 4.03. /groups listing keeps the spec 18.8.4 member-count shape. Tests extended accordingly.
